purpose: The identity a tester verifies before testing. Do not trust this file: it tells you which digests the project claims and how to recompute them from the bytes in your hands. Your report records the digest YOU observed (artifact_digest_observed) - never this file's values copied in.

independentVerification.iso: sha256sum <the .iso you were given> (PowerShell: Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256) and compare against isoSha256 - for most testers this is the one that matters
independentVerification.qcow2: sha256sum <the .qcow2 you were given> and compare against qcow2Sha256
independentVerification.raw: sha256sum <the .raw disk you were given> and compare against rawSha256
independentVerification.onMismatch: STOP. Do not boot the image. Report artifact_identity_status MISMATCH with the digest you computed and where the file came from. A mismatch is a first-class report, not your mistake.

consistency: This file must agree with qualification/phase9/intake/LEDGER.json subjectArtifact; tests/release/test_phase12_alpha_operations.py asserts it, so a drift between the tester package and the intake boundary fails the suite.
signingNote: UNSIGNED is a fact about the artifact, not a waiver: verify the digest yourself; it is the artifact's only identity.
